description: Mughal Iron & Steel Industries Limited, incorporated in 2010, operates in ferrous and non-ferrous segments; the principal activity is manufacturing and sale of mild steel products in the ferrous segment. It produces billets, rolled bars and beams, and in the non-ferrous segment ferro-alloys including ferro silicomanganese, ferro chrome and ferro silicon.
sourceNote: Company website (mughalsteel.com.pk: products, contact us) and the PSX company profile (dps.psx.com.pk/company/MUGHAL: business description, key people, address), read 2026-10-17.
